rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is damaged or no longer working.
Use this when “broken” means having no money or being broke.
Use this when something is literally shattered or broken into separate pieces, rather than merely malfunctioning.

example.english: The cup is broken into pieces.

rows.note: Use this for someone who is deeply defeated, dispirited, and emotionally shattered.

example.english: After failing the exam, they were completely broken and dispirited.
example.traditional: 佢考試失敗之後，成個人心灰意冷。
